targets.title: Information and spillovers from targeting policy in peru’s anchoveta fishery
targets.evidence_quote:
In our report prepared for the Institute for Replication (I4R) Brodeur et al. (2024),
   we utilized the publicly available replication package of the paper ”Information and
   Spillovers from Targeting Policy in Peru’s Anchoveta Fishery”.
targets.outcome_computational_quote:
Overall, the full
          analysis and graphic outputs of the paper are reproducible using the publicly
          available complementary data and code from the AEJ website despite minor
          code interpretability challenges.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
Overall, the reproduction validates the original
   paper’s findings, demonstrating robustness across various analyses with only minor
   discrepancies.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors report successful computational reproduction with negligible numerical differences and robust findings under their tested changes to standard errors and seeds.

reasoning: Re-analysis of the original data and code, without a new sample. Only Englander is re-tested; Brodeur describes the initiative.
